articles.title: Wallabies rotate forwards for Argentina Test as Suaalii settles for place on bench
articles.summary: Captain Harry Wilson left out of team entirely for clash in Jujuy. Reshaped pack ‘worthwhile exploring’, says coach Les Kiss. Coach Les Kiss has left out captain Harry Wilson and high-profile recruit Joseph-Aukuso Suaalii from the Wallabies XV to play Argentina in Jujuy this weekend as he seeks to…
body: Tighthead prop Allan Alaalatoa will captain the side for the sixth time in the absence of Wilson who, having been rested entirely, will be replaced in the starting line-up at No 8 by Rob Valetini.
The entire forward pack has been rotated following the 56-17 victory over Japan in Townsville two weeks ago, and prop Isaac Kailea comes in to play his first Test since 2024.

Kiss said he and his staff have “tried to find out how deep we can go in each position” in the front row, while they have “reshaped” the pack this weekend because they think it’s “worthwhile exploring”.
“It may not seem like order from you what you’re seeing, but it’s making sense internally with the players in particular why we’re doing those things,” he said.

articles.title: Australia’s Nicola Olyslagers soars back to form on spectacular Diamond League night
articles.summary: High jump world champion wins gold at prestigious meet in Zurich. Cam Myers impresses again in men’s 3000m with third place. Nicola Olyslagers soared back to her world champion best at the Zurich Weltklasse meeting, but even the Australian high jump great was eclipsed on a spectacular night when…
body: Alison dos Santos shattered the world mark in the men’s ‌400m hurdles, breaking a five-year old mark of 45.94, while ‌Masai Russell blazed ‌to a ‌world record in the women’s 100m hurdles, clocking 12.09sec to eclipse the previous mark of 12.12.

The most prestigious Diamond League meeting, which has long had the reputation of being the “two-hour Olympics” because of its quality, even looked as if it might deliver a third world record on the night as pole vault aces Armand Duplantis and Emmanouil Karalis both had a crack at 6.32 metres.

Amid this landmark fare, Olyslagers may have been just a bit-part player but after a disappointing season in which she lost her Commonwealth title to teammate Eleanor Patterson, she roared back to her best form with a season’s best 2.02 metres to win by two centimetres from Ukrainian Iryna Gerashchenko.
Patterson and Ukraine’s Olympic champion Yaroslava Mahuchikh both cleared 1.96m and had to settle for fourth and joint-sixth places respectively.

articles.title: Rookie QB Ty Simpson has another efficient game as Rams wrap up preseason
articles.summary: Los Angeles Rams rookie quarterback Ty Simpson might not play much or at all this regular season, but the Rams should feel pretty good about what they saw from him in the preseason. Simpson, the No.
body: Simpson, the No. 13 overall pick of this year’s NFL Draft, completed a ton of passes on Thursday night as he completed what has to be considered a successful preseason. Simpson played a half and completed 18 of 23 passes for 119 yards and a touchdown. It was a similar stat line to his first preseason game, when he completed 21 of 25 passes for 190 yards and two touchdowns against the Chiefs.
Despite the good stats in the preseason, it appears Simpson is set for a redshirt rookie season.

On Thursday night Simpson completed most of his passes, which he has done through the preseason. He has shown he is capable of quick reads and delivering short passes with good timing and accuracy. Simpson completed 12 of his first 13 passes but none of the completions went for more than 10 yards.

articles.title: Manchester City target Iliman Ndiaye but Everton value forward at £80m
articles.summary: Everton interested in taking Grealish back from City. Omar Marmoush joins Spurs in season-long loan. Manchester City have identified Iliman Ndiaye as a potential target after the £75m departure of Sávio to Tottenham Everton value the wide forward in the region of £80m.
body: With Omar Marmoush also joining Spurs, on an initial season-long loan, Enzo Maresca wants to strengthen his attacking options. He is an admirer of Ndiaye, who has played 44 times for Senegal and is contracted to Everton until 2029.

Everton are interested in bringing Jack Grealish back from City after having him on loan last season. Grealish, also on Sunderland’s list of targets, is in the final year of his deal and Maresca suggested on Thursday the 30-year-old would leave.
“Jack is here until the day that he’s not here,” he said. “It’s my duty to try to help him to give us the best and then we’ll see in the next four-five days what happens.”
City agreed a €37.5m (£34m) deal for the Palmeiras winger Allan Elias on Monday, and are monitoring Liverpool’s Cody Gakpo.

articles.title: Atlético Madrid chief insists Júlian Alvarez will ‘never, ever’ be sold to Barcelona
articles.summary: Miguel Ángel Gil Marín accuses Barça of ‘dishonesty’ Arsenal have also been linked with Argentina forward. Atlético Madrid’s chief executive appeared to slam the door on Barcelona’s pursuit of Júlian Alvarez on Thursday.
body: Speaking to Spanish broadcaster Movistar Plus, Gil Marín delivered a blistering response to ⁠Barcelona’s president, Joan Laporta, who had said on Wednesday that ​his club remained “very interested” in signing Alvarez.
Gil Marín said Atlético were united from top to bottom in refusing to negotiate with Barcelona over a deal for a player they insists is not for sale to their La Liga rivals.

“The truth is that it outrages ⁠us even more; we are repulsed by the dishonesty, the lack of ethics, transparency and professionalism, and ​we can only insist that we will not ‌negotiate with Barcelona under any ‌circumstances,” Gil Marín said.
The Barcelona vice-president, Rafa Yuste, reacted angrily to Gil Marín’s remarks. “It is a lack of manners and respect,” Yuste told Movistar. “With those words, they’ve crossed a red ‌line.”

body: John Carroll built a two-possession lead late in the first half, but Glades Central responded with scores on either side of halftime to pull within one possession and briefly shift momentum.

articles.title: Mike Vrabel provides new insight into Patriots’ decision to trade Kayshon Boutte
articles.summary: Had Kayshon Boutte remained on the Patriots’ roster for Week 1 against the Seattle Seahawks, he would have been inactive. Head coach Mike Vrabel revealed that detail Thursday night, speaking for the first time since Boutte was traded to the Houston Texans on Monday.
body: “That was one place where we do have some depth, and I think for all parties involved, that was probably the best thing,” Vrabel told reporters in Cleveland. “Without injuries, Kayshon probably would have been inactive. Unfortunately, it just, it’s kind of the way it was. It’s just with him not playing special teams.”

As Vrabel noted, New England’s wide receiver room is the deepest position on the roster, with A.J. Brown, Romeo Doubs, DeMario Douglas, Mack Hollins, Kyle Williams and Efton Chism. All six are expected to be on the team’s 53-man roster.
The Patriots added both Brown and Doubs to the mix this offseason, pushing Boutte down the depth chart. Vrabel made sure to show appreciation for Boutte, as he often did throughout last season.

“I tried to thank Kayshon as many times I could. I texted him again today,” Vrabel said. “It’s just his maturity, his growth, his ability to put into words last year and share his own personal struggle, but also the growth that he made from that. That’s positively going to affect a lot of people. And I know that that wasn’t easy for him to do, and I tell him all the time about how much I respect him for being able to do that.”

articles.title: Why tough US Open draw will be true test of Alcaraz's fitness
articles.summary: Carlos Alcaraz starts his US Open title defence against Russia's Roman Safiullin in the first serious examination of his fitness following a long-term wrist injury.
body: Second seed Alcaraz, who won the men's title in New York last year, has not played a competitive singles match for more than four months because of inflammation in his playing right wrist.

Despite his lack of action, the 23-year-old Spaniard is still considered by many as the favourite to triumph again - particularly because his great rival Jannik Sinner is not playing due to a knee injury.

The pair may have been a cut above the rest of the tour for the past two seasons, but Alcaraz coming back from a prolonged absence with such a delicate injury and beating the rest of the field - even though he is a generational talent - would be remarkable.

The seven-time major champion missed this season's French Open and Wimbledon as a result of the issue, which did not require surgery, before making his return to court in the US Open mixed doubles alongside Serena Williams earlier this week.

articles.title: Wigan thrash Hull KR on night of tributes for Boston
articles.summary: Wigan Warriors move top of Super League as they thrash Hull KR on an emotional evening as the Cherry and Whites pay tribute to the late Sir Billy Boston.
body: Wigan Warriors moved top of Super League as they thrashed Hull KR on an emotional evening as the Cherry and Whites paid tribute to the late Sir Billy Boston.

The rugby league great, who scored a remarkable 478 tries in 488 games for Wigan and helped them win three Challenge Cups and the Championship during his time with the club, died this week at the age of 92.
Liam Marshall scored a hat-trick of tries as Jai Field, Zach Eckersley, Adam Keighran and Jake Wardle all got on the scoresheet in a decent night's work for the hosts.

It was a difficult evening for the visitors who, other than Frankie Dearlove having a second-half try chalked off, offered little in trying conditions with torrential rain making an impact on the playing surface for the second half.

articles.title: Wigan thump Hull KR to go back top after emotional Boston tributes
articles.summary: Wigan celebrated the life of the late, great Sir Billy Boston by sweeping aside a weakened Hull KR side 46-0 in their Betfred Super League clash at a sodden Brick Community Stadium.
body: Boston, who was made rugby league's first knight last year, died on Tuesday morning, four days after the funeral of his wife Lady Joan.

An emotional pre-match tribute saw Boston's son Stephen carry a Wigan shirt bearing his name onto the halfway line, where it was draped over the same throne upon which Boston had sat when the club celebrated his knighthood last July.

Two seats were left vacant in the directors' box in tribute to Boston and his wife, and the home team warmed up in black T-shirts emblazoned with his number two prior to an impeccably-observed minute's silence.

Once the action got under way, Matt Peet's men duly racked up a record-extending 13th consecutive Super League win that restored them to the top of the table ahead of Leeds' trip to St Helens on Friday.

articles.title: Muniz nets first goal in a year as Fulham ease past Wimbledon
articles.summary: Rodrigo Muniz was finally all smiles again as he ended a year-long goal drought to help earn Alvaro Arbeloa his first win and see Fulham breeze past AFC Wimbledon 3-0 in the Carabao Cup.
body: The Brazilian netted his first goal since August 16, 2025 with a fine header back across goal from Kenny Tete's cross after Emile Smith Rowe had nodded the Cottagers in front to all-but secure a third-round trip to West Ham even before half-time.

"Goals are very important for strikers, we know that, and Rodrigo is working hard," Arbeloa said after full-time. "We have very good strikers with him and with Gonzalo [Garcia] - different strikers, but we need both, and both will be very important for us.
"They both scored tonight and they are so happy in the dressing room."
Wimbledon had held strong for the opening half-hour at Craven Cottage in the first ever meeting between the two London sides, but never recovered from falling behind.

articles.title: Welbeck off the mark for Chelsea in win over Wilshere's Luton
articles.summary: Danny Welbeck scored on his Chelsea debut as Xabi Alonso's first competitive game at Stamford Bridge as Blues manager ended in a 2-0 win over League One Luton in the Carabao Cup second round.
body: With transfer news about Enzo Fernandez and Emiliano Martinez swirling through the air at Stamford Bridge before kick-off, Welbeck's 50th-minute header to open his Chelsea account showed that not all signings have to be high profile.

Alonso actually named a strong Chelsea squad for this one, with Cole Palmer, Morgan Rogers and Reece James all starting in a bid to take the game seriously. They dominated the first half but Palmer and Estevao missed good chances, before Rogers hit the bar with the last kick of the half.
But Welbeck broke Luton's resistance with a bullet header from Malo Gusto to open his Chelsea account in his 19th season playing in England's top league.
His achievements are so impressive that it is worth remembering that he and Luton head coach Jack Wilshere were once Arsenal team-mates.
